question: Which epithets of the three-eyed deity receive repeated obeisance in this mantra verse?
premises: The deity is addressed as Tryambaka.
The deity is addressed as three-eyed and glorious.
Obeisance is repeated to that deity.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the three-eyed, glorious Tryambaka.
plain_english: Obeisance, obeisance to Tryambaka, the three-eyed, the glorious one.
